data.current_summary: Check a token for honeypot, admin and holder risks
data.current_description: Use before buying any token: ERC-20 on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, or any SPL/Token-2022 mint on Solana (chain=solana; a base58 address is detected automatically). Simulates a sell by a real recent buyer and a buy from the main pool with eth_call (honeypot check), reads the owner and EIP-1967 proxy, scans the bytecode for mint, blacklist, pause, fee, limit and trading-switch functions, measures liquidity in Uniswap v2/v3 and Aerodrome pools, the share of burned LP tokens and the buy tax observed in recent buys, adds the last hour of trade flow, and returns a verdict (LOW_RISK, CAUTION, HIGH_RISK) with a 0-100 safety score and every check (PASS, WARN, FAIL, UNKNOWN, INFO). Automated checks, not an audit. Cached 120 s. On Solana: mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, default-frozen accounts, pause), metadata name and symbol, and the share of the 10 largest wallets with pools and vaults (program-derived owners) counted apart; sell simulation and pool liquidity are not checked there (listed in notChecked). Uniswap v4 pools created while the new-token watcher runs (Base, Ethereum) are included: in-range depth from StateView, simulations through the PoolManager and the hook's swap powers.
data.summary_suggestion: Analyze token for honeypot, admin, and liquidity risks
data.description_suggestion: Comprehensive token risk assessment before trading. Accepts token address and optional chain parameter (Base by default; supports Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, or Solana). Performs automated checks including: honeypot simulation (sell/buy execution), admin controls (owner, proxy, bytecode scanning), liquidity analysis (Uniswap v2/v3, Aerodrome pools, burned LP share), buy tax measurement, and recent trade flow. Returns risk verdict (LOW_RISK, CAUTION, HIGH_RISK), 0-100 safety score, and individual check results (PASS, WARN, FAIL, UNKNOWN, INFO). Results cached for 120 seconds. Note: This is automated analysis, not a security audit. Solana tokens checked for mint/freeze authority and Token-2022 extensions; sell simulation and pool liquidity checks not performed on Solana.

Uniswap v4 pools created while the new-token watcher runs (Base, Ethereum) are included: in-range depth from StateView, simulations through the PoolManager and the hook's swap powers.
